title: The Four Faces of Light and the Four Counterparts of Darkness
description: From the Father of Greatness four operative Faces of Light go forth in ordered succession — First Man (guarding the five storehouses, seizing Enmity), Third Ambassador (revealing the icon in the abyss), Jesus the Radiance (raising souls toward the Height), and the Great Counsel (gathering the redeemed inward and consuming the cosmos in fire). Against them stand four Counterparts of Darkness: King of Darkness, evil counsel, desire, and the law of Sin and Death.
